answer: Joining costs a refundable bond of 220 POA locked 75 days in its own glacier, a cold vault its key alone can thaw, so a farm pays in full for every fake. Each agent holds one vertex in the work graph, a node with signed job receipts that grow over weeks and cannot be copied. Three bonded falcon auditors, picked at random each month, check a sample of vertices against the public ledger. A fake with copied or empty work loses its whole bond, half to the auditors, and its vault stays frozen.
